english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: ǵʰéwtōr tom h₃rḗǵm̥ wewked: "h₁yáǵeswo deywóm wérunom".
english: The priest said to the king: "Pray to the god Werunos."

english: Man, would you sell me this mare? I do not sell her. She carries my children. What do you sell, then? These two young horses. What will you give me? Ten cows and ten sheep. The price is good. Take the young ones, and guard them well.

english: Wise woman, the foot of my horse is bad. Show me the hoof. Is there a stone in it? There is no stone. He is hot, and he does not eat. I will heal your horse with a song. Give him water, and do not ride him for nine days. What will you sing? May bone be joined to bone, and blood to blood!

pie: kʷósmōd dréws tétḱon rótons démesi? h₁íns pr̥kʷéws dréws démoh₂. h₁íd dʰr̥ǵʰtóm. kʷóti dinóns wr̥ǵyési? kʷetwórn̥s dinóns. nu néwōy wóǵʰōy uksénn̥s yunégmi. méǵʰye wr̥ǵyḗsi? tébʰye wr̥ǵyṓh₂ h₁éwkoh₂-kʷe.
english: Carpenter, from which wood do you build wheels? I build them from the wood of the oak. It is hard. How many days do you work? Four days. Then I join the oxen to the new wagon. Will you work for me? I will work for you, and I will learn.

pie: h₂éwh₂e h₁énos ǵérh₂onts ne wr̥ǵyéti. kʷíd h₁ím h₂élesi? polh₁úns kéh₃tuns méǵʰye ḱóm gʷm̥sḱét spért-kʷe me. misdʰóm wn̥tóm? ne wént. h₁yód me tr̥h₃ént swóm me ḱóymom wéǵʰet. ǵérh₂ontm̥ priHóm likʷyéh₁s? h₁ím mē likʷyéh₁m̥. h₁ésmey gʰréh₁mn̥ déh₃oh₂.
english: Grandfather, that old one does not work. Why do you feed him? He came into many battles with me, and he rescued me. Did he win a prize? He did not win. When they wounded me, he carried me to my village. Would you leave an old friend? I would not leave him. I will give him grass.

pie: albʰṓm moy h₂éǵe h₁éḱwōs twóybʰos HéHḱyoses. príHe toy wékʷesh₂ dʰr̥súh₂. yéwgesos moy ne bʰebʰóyh₂th₂e? h₁ésmōd ne bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. pérkʷum déh₂newi h₁élh₂omes. h₁yós wéneti só misdʰóm sléh₂gʷeti. kʷíd misdʰós? h₁rudʰrós méne h₁éḱwosyo pṓlHos. deywṓs nos kʷḱih₁ént. ǵʰidʰí.
english: Driver of the white ones, my horses are swifter than yours! Your words are bold, friend. Do you not fear my team? I do not fear it. Let us drive to the oak at the river! Whoever wins shall take the prize. What is the prize? A red foal of my mare. May the gods see us! Drive on!

pie: príHe h₁éḱwōd déh₂nu h₁n̥dó péth₁m̥. kʷéḱm̥ te smḗm-kʷe. skélesih₁ toy kéh₂iloyh₁? skélesih₁ moy kéh₂iloyh₁. ḱḗr moy luǵróm. kʷíd te Hyéh₁kt? h₁ógʷʰis stóygʰom pér sérpet tósmōd-kʷe bʰéyh₂t. h₁éy h₂yuHn̥ḱós. sth₂dʰí h₁ím-kʷe h₃réyHdʰe.
english: Friend, I fell from the horse into the river! I saw you, and I laughed! Are your legs whole? My legs are whole. My heart is sad. Why did he throw you? A snake was creeping across the path, and he became afraid of it. He is young. Stand up, and ride him!

pie: kʷíd h₂énHe sh₂wéns kʷékʷlos? sóh₂wl̥ ph₂wéns kʷékʷlos. dyḗm pér wértetor. kʷís h₁énom wóǵʰom déwkti? ḱubʰrṓs márkōs h₁ím dukénti. sóh₂wl̥ widéh₁yesi? h₁íd widéh₁yoh₂ h₃ókʷih₁-kʷe moy h₁éwseti. nu sóh₂wl̥ mē spéḱyes. pṓlHons h₂éǵroy spéḱye.
english: Grandmother, what is the wheel of the sun? The sun is a wheel of fire. It turns through the sky. Who draws that wagon? Shining horses draw it. Do you see the sun? I see it, and it burns my eyes! Then do not look at the sun! Look at the foals in the field.

pie: h₂énHe h₁éḱwos nékʷti HréwdHti. kúdʰe h₁ésyeh₂s pṓlHos h₁ésti? h₂éwh₂os toy h₁ím dweh₂róybʰos h₂éǵrom wédʰet. nu h₂mélǵos ne srobʰéyeti. h₁ím mérseti? tísrn̥s nókʷtn̥s HréwdHeti. nu h₁ím mérseti. méh₂trey h₂élbʰit wékʷsperoy h₁opéyēsi? h₁ésyeh₂ey h₂élbʰit h₁opéyōh₂ h₁ésyeh₂ey-kʷe gʷéHyōh₂.
english: Grandmother, the mare is crying out in the night. Where is her foal? Your uncle led him to the far field. Now he does not suck milk. Will she forget him? She will cry out for three nights. Then she will forget him. Will you give the mother barley in the evening? I will give her barley, and I will sing to her.

pie: méh₂ter pṓlHos ḱásneh₂ey h₁éḱwōy ǵn̥h₁yéto. sth₂éh₁yeti? sth₂éh₁yeti h₂mélǵos-kʷe swéh₂s méh₂tr̥s píph₃eti. h₁íh₂m̥ próti mē h₁éys. swóm téḱnom péh₂sti. kʷód h₁nómn̥ pṓlHōy dʰéh₁omes? ph₂tḗr toy h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁eti. tékʷe tósmey-kʷe wr̥h₁dʰí. tékʷoh₂. pṓlHos h₂uksyéh₁t ḱuh₁rós-kʷe bʰuHyéh₁t.
english: Mother, a foal was born to the grey mare! Is it standing? It stands, and it drinks its mother's milk. Do not go toward her. She is guarding her young. Which name shall we set on the foal? Your father shall set its name. Run and tell him! I am running! May the foal grow up, and may it become strong!

pie: pótni moy h₁éḱwōs ḱeḱm̥h₂ḗr. wódr̥ h₁idʰé h₁ésti? h₁íns h₁énod déh₂nu wédʰe. deywṓs toy h₁wésuh₂ dh₃ih₁ént. gʰréh₁mn̥ h₁éymos h₁ésti? gʰréh₁mn̥ h₂éǵroy h₁ésti h₂élbʰit-kʷe sth₂dʰlóy h₁ésti. kʷésyo suHnús túH? h₁eǵóh₂ h₁suh₁éḱwosyo suHnús. h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ ǵn̥néh₃mi. só ḱlutós h₂eǵós.
english: Lady, my horses are tired. Is there water here? Lead them to that river yonder. May the gods give you good things! Is there grass for them? There is grass in the field, and barley in the stable. Whose son are you? I am the son of Of-Good-Horses. I know his name! He is a famous driver.

pie: kʷíd méh₂ter yugóm? yugóm dóru h₁yód dwóh₁ uksénh₁e yunégti. kʷíd h₂éḱsis? h₂éḱsis rótons h₁entér stestóh₂e. rótōs h₁ím péri wértontor. wóǵʰom toy déyḱōh₂? h₁ím moy déyḱe. h₁ésmi sédoh₂? sddʰí sh₂éymn̥-kʷe h₁pdʰí. h₁íd mē déwks.
english: Mother, what is a yoke? A yoke is wood that joins two oxen. What is an axle? The axle stands between the wheels. The wheels turn around it. Shall I show you the wagon? Show it to me! Shall I sit in it? Sit, and hold the rope. Do not pull it!

pie: h₂énHe moy spélom wéwke. téḱnom ḱléwse. HeHḱéwes h₁éḱwōs sóh₂wl̥ dyḗm pér dukénti. wékʷsperoy móri h₁n̥dó sn̥gʷént. kʷís h₁íns h₂éti h₂éyeri wodʰéyeti? h₂éwsōs diwés dʰugh₂tḗr h₁íns h₁éǵʰs wodʰéyeti. h₂éwsosm̥ h₂éyeri kʷéḱs? h₁íh₂m̥ kʷéḱm̥. h₁rudʰéh₁t.
english: Grandmother, tell me a story! Listen, child. Swift horses draw the sun through the sky. In the evening they sink into the sea. Who leads them back in the morning? Dawn, the daughter of Sky, leads them out. Did you see the Dawn in the morning? I saw her. She was red.

pie: swésor h₁sn̥tyóḱlewēs h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe h₂éyeri h₁élh₂owos. tósyo márkōs méǵh₂ih₂es. dedwóyth₂e? ne dedwóyh₂e. yéwgos moy ḱéwh₁yos. h₂uséy gʷʰédʰyōh₂. séǵʰos toy dh₃yéh₁t. h₁yód wénoh₂ h₂uséy h₁rudʰróm pṓlHom déh₃oh₂. gʷh₂dʰí h₂éti-kʷe gʷmih₁tā́m.
english: Sister, early in the morning Of-True-Fame and I will drive. His mares are big. Are you afraid? I am not afraid. My team is stronger. I will pray to the Dawn. May she give you victory! If I win, I will give the Dawn a red foal. Go, and may you come back!

pie: h₁éḱwōs tu wewkond: "ḱludʰí, h₂owey! tód spéḱyomes, n̥sméy agʰnutór ḱḗr: dʰǵʰémō, pótis, sē h₂áwyes h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ gʷʰérmom wéstrom wept, h₂áwibʰyos tu h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ né h₁esti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: príHa moy bʰh₂dʰí. kʷís h₁énos kr̥snómarkos h₂eǵós? h₁énos deywóǵenh₁ēs h₃rēǵés suHnús. tósyo márkōs h₂énh₁mōd HéHḱyoses. h₁éterom h₂eǵóm spéḱye. dʰégʷʰh₂t. deywóǵenh₁esm̥ dʰégʷʰh₂t. kʷís wéneti? h₁éteros. smḗyti. deywṓs h₁ésmey ḱléwos dh₃ih₁ént.
english: Tell me, dear one! Who is that driver with black horses? That is Of-Divine-Race, the son of the king. His mares are swifter than the wind! Look at the other driver! He has come near! He has passed Of-Divine-Race! Who will win? The other one! He is laughing! May the gods give him fame!

pie: swéḱruh₂ rótosyo ǵómbʰos lelóykʷe. kúdʰe wóǵʰos sth₂éh₁yet? gʰórdʰoy sth₂éh₁yet. ǵómbʰom gʰr̥h₁méni h₂isḱé. h₁ím h₂isḱóm h₁ím-kʷe ne widóm. nu néwom pr̥kʷéws dréws skinddʰí. ḱéstrom ph₂wéni h₁épi ḱéyor. ḱód ḱéstrom. déyḱe moy.
english: Mother-in-law, the peg of the wheel is missing. Where did the wagon stand? It stood at the fence. Seek the peg in the grass. I sought it, and I did not find it. Then cut a new one from the wood of an oak. The knife lies by the fire. This is the knife. Show me!

pie: ǵérh₂ont toy swṓy suHnówey dʰugh₂térm̥ gʷʰédʰyoh₂. kʷód h₁wédmn̥ déh₃esi? déḱm̥ h₁éḱwons dwirótom-kʷe wóǵʰom. tód péh₂urom. dʰugh₂tḗr moy h₁wésu téksti gʷéHyeti-kʷe. nu albʰéh₂m márkom HéHḱisteh₂m éti déh₃oh₂. h₁wédmn̥ h₁áyoh₂er. dʰugh₂térm̥ moy swóm dṓm sémeh₂i wédʰe. suHnús toy h₃réyHdʰeti? tríns pṓlHons démh₂t.
english: Elder, I ask for your daughter for my son. What bride-price will you give? Ten horses and a two-wheeled wagon. That is little. My daughter weaves well, and she sings. Then I will also give a white mare, the swiftest one. I shall take the bride-price. Lead my daughter to your house in the summer. Does your son ride? He tamed three foals.

pie: kʷíd h₂éwh₂e wóǵʰos gʷr̥dú h₁éyti? h₂éḱsis h₂susyéti. smérum moy bʰére. ḱós smérus. kúdʰe h₁ím h₂linéHoh₂? h₁ím h₂éḱsēy rótoysu h₁épi h₂linHdʰí. widéh₁yesi? nu rótōs wértontor. wértontor. nu uksénes wóǵʰom moḱs dukénti.
english: Grandfather, why does the wagon go slowly? The axle is dry. Bring me the grease. This is the grease. Where shall I smear it? Smear it on the axle, at the wheels. Do you see? Now the wheels turn. They turn! Now the oxen pull the wagon quickly.

pie: wóyḱe moy kr̥snóm h₁éḱwom kʷéḱs? nékʷti léytt. h₁ím ne kʷéḱm̥. ḱoph₂óns déh₂newi h₂éyeri ḱlḗm. wiHrṓs h₁ím h₂epó h₁l̥h₂ént? ne wóydh₂e. ḱoph₂ṓm stóygʰom sékʷōmesdʰh₂. kúdʰe toy ḱwṓ h₁ésti? ḱwṓ moy h₁idʰé h₁ésti. h₂ḱh₂owsyéti. h₁yód kʷis kr̥snóm stéh₂yet wiḱpótis tóm kʷéyēti.
english: Neighbour, did you see my black stallion? He went away in the night. I did not see him. Early in the morning I heard hooves at the river. Did men drive him away? I do not know. Let us follow the path of the hooves. Where is your dog? My dog is here. He hears well. If anyone stole the black one, the chief will punish that man.

pie: h₂éwh₂e moy pṓlHom h₁wogʷʰéyes. kʷóterom wélh₁oh₂? ḱásnos gʷr̥dús. h₁rudʰrós HeHḱús. kʷóterom wéḱsi? h₁rudʰróm wéḱmi. h₁ésmōd ne bʰebʰóyh₂e. dʰŕ̥sew. dʰéǵʰōm te Hyéh₁keti. nu h₂éti stéh₂oh₂ h₁rudʰróm-kʷe démh₂oh₂. sh₂éymn̥ h₁pdʰí. h₁éy twós.
english: Uncle, you promised me a foal. Which of the two shall I choose? The grey one is slow. The red one is swift. Which do you want? I want the red one! I do not fear him. Bold one! He will throw you to the ground. Then I will stand up again, and I will tame the red one. Take hold of the rope. He is yours.

pie: tétḱon moy wóǵʰosyo rótos pr̥wéni Hrumptó. rótom moy déyḱe. h₂éḱsis éti Hrumptó? h₂éḱsis kéh₂ilos. rótos dwís bʰindtó. néwom rótom pr̥kʷéws dréws démōh₂. méne ph₂wéni h₁épi sddʰí h₁ddʰí-kʷe. kʷóm rótom h₂réydʰēsi? h₁ím h₂éyeri h₂réydʰōh₂. nu swóy stóygʰoy ǵʰéyesi. kúdʰe h₁éysi? méne bʰréh₂tr̥s ḱóymom.
english: Carpenter, the wheel of my wagon broke at the ford. Show me the wheel. Did the axle break too? The axle is whole. The wheel split in two. I will build a new wheel from the wood of an oak. Sit down by my fire and eat. When will you make the wheel ready? I will make it ready early in the morning. Then you will drive on along your path. Where are you going? To the village of my brother.

pie: h₁wésuḱlewes me ḱHsdʰí. kʷíh₁ márkoybʰos yugóm dʰédʰeh₁omes? tā́s pró yugóm Hn̥dʰí wédʰe. nu sh₂éymn̥h₂ téh₂sōm kólsons péri bʰéndʰe. ḱód deḱsiwóm? tód deḱsiwóm. widéh₁yesi? kr̥snéh₂ albʰéh₂m dénḱt. dúsmenes. h₁íh₂m̥ stunédoh₂? h₁íh₂m̥ mē stunéds h₁ésyeh₂ey-kʷe bʰh₂dʰí. swósyo póteys wékʷesh₂ ǵn̥nh₃énti.
english: Of-Goodly-Fame, teach me! How shall we put the yoke on the mares? First lead them under the yoke. Then bind the ropes around their necks. Is this right? It is right. Do you see? The black one bit the white one. Ill-minded one! Shall I strike her? Do not strike her; speak to her. They know the words of their master.

pie: kúdʰe swésor h₁éḱwons wodʰéyesi? déh₂nu. tr̥syónti. méǵʰye ḱóm gʷémesi? gʷémoh₂. ḱásneh₂i márkoy h₁épi h₃réyHdʰe. h₁íh₂ gʷr̥déwih₂. pró ne h₃réyHdʰom. dedwóyh₂e. mē bʰéyh₂s. h₁ésyeh₂s gʷriHwéh₂m h₁pdʰí bʰérēti-kʷe te.
english: Sister, where are you leading the horses? To the river. They are thirsty. Will you come with me? I will come! Ride on the grey mare. She is slow. I did not ride before. I am afraid. Do not be afraid. Hold her mane, and she will carry you.

pie: príHe yéwgos ǵʰidʰí. h₁regʷesyéti. rótōs wértontor. ḱḗr toy trémti? trémti. snusósyo moy bʰréh₂teres dʰr̥ǵʰtṓs. h₁wédmn̥ kʷinéws. h₁íh₂m̥ toy déh₃onti. kʷetwórn̥s h₁éḱwons uksénm̥-kʷe kʷinḗm. h₁éneh₂ dʰwṓr. snusós toy h₂én sth₂éh₁yeti.
english: Friend, drive the team on! It is getting dark! The wheels are turning. Is your heart trembling? It trembles. The brothers of my bride are hard. You paid the bride-price. They will give her to you. I paid four horses and a bull. That yonder is the door! Your bride stands there.

pie: déywoḱlewes nos HeHḱuyéh₂s márkosyo kéh₂nmn̥ kh₂né. ḱléwsete. h₃rēǵés márkos solh₂wóns h₂élyons léykʷt. h₁íh₂m̥ kʷis ne h₁épt. kʷóm misdʰóm h₃rḗǵs h₁ésyeh₂ey déh₃t? h₂élbʰit ń̥dʰgʷʰitom-kʷe ḱléwos. kéh₂nmn̥ toy méǵʰye sweh₂dú. nu moy m̥dʰéws péh₃tlom déh₃esi? dwóyh₁ toy péh₃tloyh₁ déh₃oh₂.
english: Fame-from-the-Gods, sing us a song of the swift mare! Listen! The king's mare left all the others behind. No one seized her. What prize did the king give her? Barley, and imperishable fame. Your song is sweet to me. Then will you give me a cup of mead? I will give you two cups.

pie: póh₂imen moy wéwke. kʷóti h₁éḱwōs gʰréh₁mn̥ h₂éǵroy h₁édn̥ti? déḱm̥ márkōs septḿ̥-kʷe pṓlHōs. kʷetwóres pṓlHōs péruti h₁sént. deywṓs nos stérgonti. wĺ̥kʷons nékʷti ḱlḗm. pṓlHons h₂lékse déh₃rom-kʷe toy déh₃oh₂. wíḱpotey h₁íns swṓys ḱwn̥bʰís h₂léksōh₂. kʷód moy déh₃rom déh₃esi? h₁yód solh₂wṓs gʷíh₃wōnti h₁wésistom toy pṓlHom déh₃oh₂.
english: Shepherd, tell me! How many horses are eating grass in the field? Ten mares and seven foals. Last year there were four foals. The gods cherish us. I heard wolves in the night. Protect the foals, and I will give you a gift. I will protect them with my dogs, chief. What gift will you give me? If all live, I will give you the best foal.
